lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਓਥੈ ਕੂੜੇ ਨਾ ਟਿਕੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare othai kooRe naa tika(n)n ||
lines.translation: True is the Banker, and True are His traders. The false ones cannot remain there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚੰਨਿ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: onaa sach na bhaavaee dukh hee maahi pacha(n)n ||18||
lines.translation: They do not love the Truth - they are consumed by their pain. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mailaa jag phirai mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaar ||
lines.translation: The world wanders around in the filth of egotism; it dies, and is re-born, over and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: paiai kirat kamaavanaa koi na metanahaar ||19||
lines.translation: He acts in accordance with the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat mil rahai taa sach lagai piaar ||
lines.translation: But if he joins the Society of the Saints, then he comes to embrace love for the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: sach salaahee sach man dar sachai sachiaar ||20||
lines.translation: Praising the True Lord with a truthful mind, he becomes true in the Court of the True Lord. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore pooree mat hai ahinis naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: The Teachings of the Perfect Guru are perfect; meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: haumai meraa vad rog hai vichahu thaak rahaai ||21||
lines.translation: Egotism and self-conceit are terrible diseases; tranquility and stillness come from within. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur saalaahee aapanaa niv niv laagaa paai ||
lines.translation: I praise my Guru; bowing down to Him again and again, I fall at His Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੀ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: tan man saupee aagai dharee vichahu aap gavaai ||22||
lines.translation: I place my body and mind in offering unto Him, eradicating self-conceit from within. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿੰਚੋਤਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khi(n)chotaan vigucheeai ekas siu liv laai ||
lines.translation: Indecision leads to ruin; focus your attention on the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: haumai meraa chhad too taa sach rahai samaai ||23||
lines.translation: Renounce egotism and self-conceit, and remain merged in Truth. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਭਾਇਰਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur no mile s bhaairaa sachai sabad laga(n)n ||
lines.translation: Those who meet with the True Guru are my Siblings of Destiny; they are committed to the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: sach mile se na vichhuRahi dar sachai disa(n)n ||24||
lines.translation: Those who merge with the True Lord shall not be separated again; they are judged to be True in the Court of the Lord. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: se bhaaee se sajanaa jo sachaa seva(n)n ||
lines.translation: They are my Siblings of Destiny, and they are my friends, who serve the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਿ ਪਲੑਰਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝ ਕਰੰਨੑਿ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: avagan vikan palhran gun kee saajh kara(n)nhi ||25||
lines.translation: They sell off their sins and demerits like straw, and enter into the partnership of virtue. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun kee saajh sukh oopajai sachee bhagat karen ||
lines.translation: In the partnership of virtue, peace wells up, and they perform true devotional worship service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਨਿ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: sach vana(n)jahi gurasabad siu laahaa naam laen ||26||
lines.translation: They deal in Truth, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and they earn the profit of the Naam. ||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: suinaa rupaa paap kar kar sa(n)cheeai chalai na chaladiaa naal ||
lines.translation: Gold and silver may be earned by committing sins, but they will not go with you when you die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਸੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai naal na chalasee sabh muthee jamakaal ||27||
lines.translation: Nothing will go with you in the end, except the Name; all are plundered by the Messenger of Death. ||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kaa tosaa har naam hai hiradai rakhahu samhaal ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is the nourishment of the mind; cherish it, and preserve it carefully within your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਖਰਚੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: ehu kharach akhut hai guramukh nibahai naal ||28||
lines.translation: This nourishment is inexhaustible; it is always with the Gurmukhs. ||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man moolahu bhuliaa jaasahi pat gavaai ||
lines.translation: O mind, if you forget the Primal Lord, you shall depart, having lost your honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: ihu jagat mohi doojai viaapiaa guramatee sach dhiaai ||29||
lines.translation: This world is engrossed in the love of duality; follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the True Lord. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee keemat naa pavai har jas likhan na jaai ||
lines.translation: The Lord's value cannot be estimated; the Lord's Praises cannot be written down.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad man tan rapai har siu rahai samaai ||30||
lines.translation: When one's mind and body are attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one remains merged in the Lord. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sahu meraa ra(n)gulaa ra(n)ge sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: My Husband Lord is playful; He has imbued me with His Love, with natural ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਾ ਚੜੈ ਜਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman ra(n)g taa chaRai jaa pir kai a(n)k samaai ||31||
lines.translation: The soul-bride is imbued with His Love, when her Husband Lord merges her into His Being. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: chiree vichhu(n)ne bhee milan jo satigur seva(n)n ||
lines.translation: Even those who have been separated for so very long, are reunited with Him, when they serve the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਖਾਨਿ ਖਰਚਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟਈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੰਨਿ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar nav nidh naam hai khaan kharachan na nikhutaee har gun sahaj rava(n)n ||32||
lines.translation: The nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deep within the nucleus of the self; consuming them, they are still never exhausted. Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with natural ease. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਨਾ ਮਰਹਿ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa oi janamahi naa marahi naa oi dukh saha(n)n ||
lines.translation: They are not born, and they do not die; they do not suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare har siu kel kara(n)n ||33||
lines.translation: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They celebrate with the Lord. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sajan mile na vichhuRahi j anadin mile raha(n)n ||
lines.translation: Those who are united with the Lord, the True Friend, are not separated again; night and day, they remain blended with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੩੪॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: is jag mahi virale jaaneeahi naanak sach laha(n)n ||34||1||3||
lines.translation: In this world, only a rare few are known, O Nanak, to have obtained the True Lord. ||34||1||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jee sookham agam hai kit bidh miliaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord is subtle and inaccessible; how can we ever meet Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad bhram kateeai achi(n)t vasai man aai ||1||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, doubt is dispelled, and the Carefree Lord comes to abide in the mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har har naam japa(n)n ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
